title: editFile
body:
## editFile

Apply ordered typed edits to a captured copy of an existing HDF5 file - create, delete, move, copy, link, set or delete attributes, write selections, resize, append, make/attach/detach dimension scales and change storage layout - optionally repacking into a fresh file to reclaim space.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The source is captured and never modified; the edited copy is published under a new name.
- Each edit is checked against the simulated state from the independent reading of the source before native work.
- Copies re-attach dimension scales: scales inside the copied tree map to their copies, others stay shared.
- copyChunks writes stored chunks unchanged; fresh chunk listings must show the source bytes in the target.
- write with fields changes only those compound members; the other members of each record keep their stored values.

Native binding: `h5py.File(r+) on a captured copy: create/__delitem__/move/copy/attrs/__setitem__ selection writes/resize/dims.attach_scale/make_scale; optional full copy repack`. Output kind: `["file","text","table"]`.

Inputs: none.
